candidate.answerReason: Equating the costs gives 20 + 0.1t = 0.2t, so t = 200 minutes. Both plans then cost 40 yuan.

methods.label: Equate the plan costs
methods.explanation: Let the call duration be \(t\) minutes. Then \(20+0.1t=0.2t\), giving \(0.1t=20\) and \(t=200\).
methods.levelReason: Writing the two costs and solving a linear equation with unknowns on both sides are grade 7 procedures.

methods.label: Balance the fixed fee with call savings
methods.explanation:
Plan A charges 20 yuan more in fixed fees but saves \(0.2-0.1=0.1\) yuan on each minute of calls. The costs are equal when those savings cover the 20-yuan fee, so the required call duration is
\[
20\div0.1=200\text{ minutes}.
\]
methods.levelReason: Uses decimal subtraction and division to accumulate savings, providing a grade 5 arithmetic route.
